name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive 0.6 preview with animated Pokemon Stadium 2 models for nearby visible underwater wildlife when a Crystal 251 DSM4 cache is available. Stadium models use the active voxel provider's StadiumRig, smooth heading/depth motion, Pokédex-based compressed physical scale, morphology correction, effect/material animation and distance-limited LOD with automatic sprite fallback. Retains expanded Full-Kanto seabeds, visible-only Wilds encounters, seamless underwater connections, salvage and HM08 DIVE.
